requests_expected.definition: Measured requests the profile asked for (warmup excluded).

requests_attempted.definition: Measured request attempts sent (retries count separately).

requests_succeeded.definition: Measured attempts that ended with a complete response.

requests_failed.definition: Measured attempts that ended with an error (HTTP, stream or server error).

requests_timeout.definition: Measured attempts stopped at their deadline.

requests_cancelled.definition: Measured attempts cancelled by the client.

requests_incomplete.definition: Measured attempts with no final status when the run ended (unresolved).

requests_with_first_token.definition: Measured attempts that received at least one output token.

retries.definition: Attempts that retry an earlier attempt (credited once if they succeed).

warmup_requests.definition: Warmup requests (never part of any metric).

error_rate.definition: (failed + timeout + cancelled + incomplete) / attempted measured requests.

first_token_response_rate.definition: Attempts with at least one output token / attempted. A first token is not a successful completion.

output_length_mismatches.definition: Succeeded requests whose output token count differs from the requested exact length (profiles that ignore EOS).

requests_exact_chunk_tokens.definition: Succeeded requests whose every streamed chunk carried an exact server-reported token count.

input_tokens_succeeded.definition: Prompt tokens of succeeded measured requests.

output_tokens_succeeded.definition: Output tokens of succeeded measured requests (server usage count).

output_tokens_unsuccessful.definition: Output tokens streamed to measured requests that did not succeed (partial, failed, superseded). Never credited.

cohort_duration_s.definition: From the start of main scheduling (warmup excluded) to the last measured completion or deadline. Drain included.

finite_cohort_output_tps.definition: Successful cohort output tokens / cohort duration.

finite_cohort_input_tps.definition: Successful cohort input tokens / cohort duration.

finite_cohort_total_tps.definition: Successful cohort input + output tokens / cohort duration (same cohort).
finite_cohort_total_tps.numerator: input + output tokens of succeeded requests

output_tps_per_gpu.definition: Deployment output tok/s (finite cohort or steady successful) / all allocated physical GPUs, idle and prefill GPUs included.

input_tps_per_gpu.definition: Deployment input tok/s / all allocated physical GPUs.

total_tps_per_gpu.definition: Deployment total tok/s / all allocated physical GPUs.

output_event_tps_max_10s.definition: Diagnostic: the largest output-token arrival rate in any 10 s window of the main phase (all requests). Not a headline.

steady_window_s.definition: Length of the declared steady phase (ramp and drain excluded).

steady_output_event_tps.definition: Output tokens received inside the steady window (any request) / window seconds.

successful_steady_output_tps.definition: In-window output tokens of requests that eventually succeeded / window seconds (status known after drain).

steady_failed_request_tokens.definition: In-window output tokens of requests that did not succeed.

steady_unresolved_requests.definition: Requests with in-window tokens whose final status was still unknown after drain.

steady_unresolved_tokens.definition: In-window tokens of unresolved requests (neither successful nor failed; never credited).

steady_completions.definition: Succeeded requests whose terminal response arrived inside the window.

steady_first_token_responses.definition: Requests whose first output token arrived inside the window.

steady_boundary_started_before.definition: Requests sent before the window that completed inside it.

steady_boundary_ended_after.definition: Requests sent inside the window that completed after it.

steady_boundary_spanning.definition: Requests sent before the window and completed after it.

steady_cohort_requests.definition: Requests SENT inside the window (cohort of the per-query medians).

achieved_completion_rps.definition: Succeeded requests / (arrival start to end of drain).

ttft_ms.definition: First content chunk arrival minus send. Succeeded measured requests.

e2e_terminal_ms.definition: Terminal response (stream end) minus send. Succeeded measured requests.

e2e_last_token_ms.definition: Last content chunk arrival minus send: the pinned InferenceX client's E2EL. Succeeded measured requests.

tpot_native_ms.definition: Pinned InferenceX TPOT: (E2EL - TTFT) / (N - 1), N > 1, E2EL ending at the last content chunk. Its reciprocal is the client's 'interactivity'.

tpot_terminal_ms.definition: (terminal response latency - TTFT) / (N - 1), N > 1. Differs from the native TPOT by the stream's closing delay.

span_last_first_ms.definition: (last token - first token) / (N - 1), N > 1. Equal to the native TPOT by construction of the pinned client; named separately as the specification asks.

itl_token_ms.definition: Gaps between consecutive output tokens, from requests whose every chunk carried exactly one token (exact). Requests with multi-token chunks are excluded and counted.

chunk_gap_ms.definition: Gaps between consecutive content chunks (all succeeded requests): the pinned client's ITL. A multi-token chunk is ONE gap, never several zero gaps.

itl_estimated_uniform_ms.definition: ESTIMATE, only when multi-token chunks exist: each chunk gap divided evenly among its tokens.

client_queue_delay_ms.definition: Send minus scheduled time (client-side wait for a concurrency slot or a late arrival).

user_speed_post_first_token_tps.definition: (N - 1) / (last token - first token), N > 1: generation speed one user sees after the first token.

user_speed_e2e_tps.definition: N / (last token - send): speed one user sees including the wait for the first token.

interactivity_native_median_tps.definition: 1000 / median native TPOT (ms): the pinned client's 'median_intvty'.

slo_qualifying_requests.definition: Succeeded measured requests that meet every request-level SLO condition together.

request_goodput_rps.definition: Qualifying requests / the lane's duration (finite: cohort duration; steady: qualifying completions inside the window / window).

output_goodput_tps.definition: Output tokens of qualifying requests / the lane's duration (steady: their in-window tokens / window).

server_running_requests.definition: Running requests in the server's decode batches during the main phase (the actual kernel batch, not client concurrency).

server_queue_depth.definition: Requests waiting in the server queue during the main phase.

server_token_usage.definition: KV token pool usage reported by the server.

server_retractions.definition: Decode retractions (a request's state discarded and rebuilt by prefill) during the run.

server_cuda_graph_fraction.definition: Share of decode log lines that ran a CUDA graph.

server_reported_gen_tps.definition: The server's own generation throughput readings (diagnostic, not a headline).

gpu_memory_used_mib.definition: Device memory in use (nvidia-smi), whole device, during the main phase.

gpu_power_w.definition: GPU board power (nvidia-smi power.draw), during the main phase. GPU only, not host or facility.

gpu_sm_clock_mhz.definition: SM clock during the main phase (thermal/clock telemetry).

gpu_temperature_c.definition: GPU temperature during the main phase.

gpu_energy_j.definition: Integral of GPU power over the measurement interval (trapezoid), only with adequate sample coverage.

gpu_energy_j_per_output_token.definition: GPU energy / successful output tokens of the same interval.

gpu_energy_j_per_qualified_output_token.definition: GPU energy / output tokens of SLO-qualifying requests.

usd_per_hour.definition: Deployment cost per hour from pricing.json under its cost mode (null when no price is recorded).

usd_per_million_output_tokens.definition: USD/h x 1e6 / (3600 x successful deployment output tok/s).

usd_per_million_input_tokens.definition: Alternative view: the WHOLE deployment cost attributed to input tokens. Not additive with the output view.

usd_per_million_total_tokens.definition: Alternative view: the whole deployment cost attributed to input + output tokens. Never an output-token cost.
